scaleme.midnightconfig.title: ScaleMe - Visual Scaling
scaleme.midnightconfig.ownPlayerDescript: Adjust the visual size of your own player model
scaleme.midnightconfig.ownPlayerScale.to: Controls how large or small your own player appears visually
scaleme.midnightconfig.smoothScaling.too: Gradually transition between scale changes for your own player
scaleme.midnightconfig.playersDescriptio: Adjust the visual size of other players and manage scaling presets
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableOtherPlayer: Allow scaling of other players' models (visual only)
scaleme.midnightconfig.otherPlayersScale: Controls how large or small other players appear visually
scaleme.midnightconfig.applyToAllPlayers: Use the 'Other Players Scale' setting for all players, including yourself
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableCrosshairIn: Display the crosshair when viewing from behind your character (F5 once)
Display the crosshair when viewing from in front of your character (F5 twice)
Prevent cycling to front-facing third person view when pressing F5
Allow scaling of Hypixel NPC player models (visual only)
scaleme.midnightconfig.npcPlayerScale.to: Controls how large or small Hypixel NPC players appear visually
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableVillagerNpc: Allow scaling of Hypixel Villager NPC models (visual only)
Controls how large or small Hypixel Villager NPCs appear visually
